findings.explanation: Jason Young is a common name. The roster only places a Jason Young in the 2011 men's discus, while the USADA text gives track and field, age 35, and a Texas residence, not an event or birth date. The proposed exclusion of a namesake is not in these documents.
findings.suggestion: Do not attach this roster until a supplied document ties the Lubbock sanction to this discus thrower by birth date or event.
